inclusion_rule: Intracranial (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical) speech decoding studies whose ledger text mentions real-time, online or closed-loop operation; the design of interest is what the evaluation reports for that operation: an online accuracy or error-rate figure, an offline simulation or replay of the real-time pipeline, and a numeric latency. Boundary: listening-only and review papers enter through the pattern, so counts are upper bounds; versions once.

read_fulltext.quote: We observed single-trial sentence classification accuracies of 90% or higher for each subject with less than 7 minutes of training data, demonstrating the ability of rtNSR to use cortical recordings to perform accurate real-time speech decoding in a limited vocabulary setting.

Despite the fact that the evaluations in this article have been performed offline, all processing steps of Brain-to-Text and the decoding approach are well suited for eventual real-time online application on desktop computers.
On the first day of system use, following 30 minutes of attempted speech training data, the neuroprosthesis achieved 99.6% accuracy with a 50-word vocabulary.
